paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually compares the performance of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—in generating empathetic responses, as judged by Gemini. The chart is structured as a concentric donut with three distinct colored segments: a large dark red segment representing GPT-4o (98.4%), a smaller light blue segment for LLaMA (3.2%), and a thin, lighter blue segment for Mistral (1.2%). The chart includes a legend and percentage labels connected by lines to their respective segments. Notably, the GPT-4o segment is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded or offset from the center, drawing attention to its dominant win rate. The segments appear to be ordered in descending size, with GPT-4o occupying the vast majority of the chart, followed by LLaMA and then Mistral.
